title: Biofunctionalization of porcine-derived collagen matrices with platelet rich fibrin: influence on angiogenesis in vitro and in vivo
authors: Blatt S, Burkhardt V, Kämmerer PW, Pabst AM, Sagheb K, Heller M, Al-Nawas B, Schiegnitz E. Clin Oral Investig. Oct 2020. 24(10): 3425-3436. doi: 10.1007/s00784-020-03213-8.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “PRF improved the angiogenesis of CM in vitro and in vivo. Clinical Relevance: Bio-functionalization of CM with PRF could easily implemented in the clinical pathway and may lead to advanced soft tissue healing. 7” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
